title: GIF Mask Brush fix grows the whole frame mask: composed export binarises the soft engine edge
description: A brushed GIF frame re-exports its mask through MaskManager.getURL(bg, fg), which snaps every alpha above 0 to full white. BiRefNet masks carry a soft falloff, so the composite grows by the feather width and Cut-out shows (and cuts) a halo on that frame only. Export coverage instead.
